report.explanation: All admitted evidence is healthy: order checkout trace OK at 69ms, gateway/order/payment logs 200 ok, gateway error_rate 0.001, p95 75ms, zero pool waiters and timeouts. The payment deployment (3.2.8, 606 min old, valid config) proves only version facts, not causation. No current evidence supports any taxonomy cause, so hand off for the missing failure signal.
missing_evidence: No error or latency signal in any service; need telemetry showing the actual checkout failure (error rate, p95, timeouts) to bound a cause.
No db_pool_waiters or dependency_timeouts above zero; need pool saturation or timeout data to test db-pool-exhaustion or downstream-latency.
No memory-retention time series for any service; a leak cannot be assessed from a single snapshot.
No configuration diff or invalid-config evidence; bad-configuration is untested.
No redis or downstream dependency latency/error telemetry to test redis-timeout or downstream-latency.
